info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Parking Reservations Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API enables users to access the current status of their parking reservations. This endpoint provides real-time insights into reservation details, allowing consumers to verify active reservations and understand availability. Typical users include parking management systems and mobile applications that assist drivers in locating suitable parking options. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance customer experiences and optimize parking solutions.

get.summary: Fetch the current status of reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of their reservations, providing details such as confirmation numbers, dates, and any changes to the reservation status.
